final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS standing, AVG(modelconf) AS confidence FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(confidence) AS overall_confidence FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT standing, confidence, confidence - overall_confidence AS difference FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE overall_confidence IS NOT NULL AND confidence > overall_confidence), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(confidence) AS selected_confidence FROM step3) SELECT standing, confidence, difference, confidence / selected_confidence FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4 WHERE selected_confidence IS NOT NULL
